english.title: Fail to comply with directions re street works - New Road and Street Works Act 1991
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an undertaker discharging your duty in relation to a highway, namely **(..SPECIFY HIGHWAY..), in respect of the placing, maintenance or operation of traffic signs, failed to comply with directions given by the traffic authority, namely **(..SPECIFY DIRECTIONS NOT COMPLIED WITH..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 65(4) of the New Roads and Street Works Act 1991.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being an undertaker discharging his/her duty in relation to a highway
in respect of the placing/maintenance/operation of traffic signs
failed to comply with the directions given by the traffic authority

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See Section 48(4) for definition of "undertaker".
(ii) The penalty for this offence was raised to level five as from 01/04/08 by section 40 of and Schedule 1 to the Traffic Management Act 2004.
(iii) See also H1025, H1027, H1028, H1062 and H1063.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
